def mesh(name,verts,faces,material):
    data=bpy.data.meshes.new(name);data.from_pydata(verts,[],faces);data.update()
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,data);C.objects.link(o);data.materials.append(material)
    uv=data.uv_layers.new(name='UVMap')
    for p in data.polygons:
        axes=[a for a in range(3) if a!=max(range(3),key=lambda a:abs(p.normal[a]))]
        for li in p.loop_indices:
            v=data.vertices[data.loops[li].vertex_index].co
            uv.data[li].uv=(v[axes[0]]*1.25,v[axes[1]]*.5)
    return o

    if bev:

def tube(name,points,r,material,sides=8,smooth=True):
    vs=[];fs=[]
    for i,point in enumerate(points):
        tangent=Vector(points[min(i+1,len(points)-1)])-Vector(points[max(i-1,0)])
        tangent.normalize();ref=Vector((0,0,1)) if abs(tangent.z)<.9 else Vector((0,1,0))
        a=tangent.cross(ref).normalized();b=tangent.cross(a).normalized();rad=r[i] if isinstance(r,list) else r
        for j in range(sides):vs.append(Vector(point)+(a*math.cos(j*math.tau/sides)+b*math.sin(j*math.tau/sides))*rad)
    for i in range(len(points)-1):
        for j in range(sides):
            n=i*sides+j;nn=i*sides+(j+1)%sides;fs.append((n,nn,nn+sides,n+sides))
    fs.extend([tuple(range(sides-1,-1,-1)),tuple((len(points)-1)*sides+j for j in range(sides))])
    o=mesh(name,vs,fs,material)
    for p in o.data.polygons:p.use_smooth=smooth and len(p.vertices)==4
    return o
